{if:SF_24}{c_label}Cooldown:{/c_label} {c_resource}{Cooldown Time}{/c} seconds
{/if}{if:SF_23}{c_label}Charges:{/c} {c_resource}[SF_23 + 1]{/c}
{c_label}Charge Cooldown:{/c_label} {c_resource}{Recharge Time}{/c} seconds
{/if}A {c_important}{u}Barrier{/u}{/c} of ice forms around you for {c_number}{buffduration:ICE_BARRIER}{/c} seconds, absorbing {c_number}[{SF_0}*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}({shield:ICE_BARRIER}){/c} in damage.
{c_important}Ice Armor{/c} grants {u}{c_important}Unstoppable{/c}{/u} for {c_number}{SF_5}{/c} second and increases your Armor by {c_number}[SF_6 * 100 |%|]{/c} while active.
{c_important}Ice Armor{/c} forms {c_number}{SF_11}{/c} {u}{c_important}Ice Spikes{/c}{/u} per second under Close enemies that deal {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEB_ICE_SPIKE_TOOLTIP}{/c} damage.
{c_important}Ice Armor{/c} also applies to Nearby Allies and increases All Resistances by {c_number}[SF_21 * 100 |%x|]{/c}.
{c_important}Ice Armor's{/c} duration is increased to {c_number}[Mod.Upgrade1 ? SF_1 : (SF_1 + SF_13)]{/c} seconds and its Barrier amount is increased by {c_number}[SF_12 * 100 |%x|]{/c}.
Close enemies that attack you while {c_important}Ice Armor{/c} is active will be {c_important}{u}Frozen{/c}{/u} or {c_important}{u}Chilled{/c}{/u} for {c_number}[SF_16|%|]{/c}.
{c_important}Ice Armor's{/c} Cooldown is reduced to {c_number}[Mod.Upgrade3? SF_2 : (SF_2 - SF_17)]{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Ice Armor{/c} grants {c_number}{SF_19}{/c} Mana Regeneration while active.
